source_clauses: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.statement: The clamp must fix a monitor arm to the edge of a desk.
The clamp must fit desk edges with thickness between 18 and 40 mm.
Once tight, the clamp must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
The clamp must be removable and movable to another desk without tools.

scenarios.description: Using the clamp to fix a monitor arm to a desk edge.
Tightening the clamp so it holds the arm.
Removing the clamp from the desk.
Moving the clamp to another desk and reattaching it.

actors.name: monitor arm
actors.role: to be fixed by the clamp

actors.name: desk edge
actors.role: surface to which the clamp is fixed

actors.name: user
actors.role: operates the clamp (tightening, removing, moving) without tools

freedoms: The specific mechanism for clamping is not specified.
The material of the clamp is not specified.
The dimensions of the clamp beyond fitting the desk edge thickness are not specified.
The weight of the monitor arm is not specified.
ambiguities: The phrase 'under the weight of the arm' is ambiguous: it does not specify whether the arm is in a particular position or moving.
The phrase 'without any tools' is ambiguous: it does not specify whether this applies only to removal and moving, or also to installation and tightening.
assumptions: The clamp is intended for a typical monitor arm, but the weight is not known.
